items.title: Stock Market Enjoys August Gains—Thanks to Unusual Winners
items.summary: August was good to U.S. stock investors. All three major U.S. indexes finished the month in the green—something that hasn't happened since May. The tech-focused Nasdaq led the way, up 3.9% for the month.

items.title: There Was No Beating Moderna in August. These Are the Best and Worst S&P 500 Stocks for the Month.
items.summary: Moderna stock surged 158% in August to lead the S&P 500, while Edison International plunged 27% to rank last in the index.

items.title: Is Merck Stock Outperforming the Nasdaq?
items.summary: Merck has surged past the broader Nasdaq Composite over the past year, and analysts remain somewhat optimistic about the stock’s growth potential.

items.title: Merck (MRK) Posts First Positive Phase 3 Result For Personalized mRNA Melanoma Therapy
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) and Moderna report the first positive Phase 3 results for an individualized mRNA neoantigen cancer therapy in melanoma patients. The therapy was tested in combination with Merck's immunotherapy KEYTRUDA in a Phase 3 trial setting. This marks the first time an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen approach has shown clinically meaningful and statistically significant Phase 3 data in cancer.
